records.quote: For safety, inspect the tire tread regularly and replace the tires before their tread wear indicators become visible.
records.note: Manual MSA5M2502A_B, page 511. We read all of section 11-16 Tires and wheels (pages 506 to 513) and the tire specifications (pages 535 and 536): they give no age at which to replace or check a tire. records.title: WSB-TV, November 11, 2016: “Costco CEO shares tips with Clark Howard to help you save money”
records.quote: Pointing to Kirkland Signature batteries, he explained, “Now, this brand here is no advertising, there's no overhead, there's just packaging. We don't advertise it. It’s just a brand.” … He also told Clark that Duracell makes Kirkland Signature batteries.
records.note: The CEO was Craig Jelinek. The Duracell sentence is the reporter's summary, not a quote. It says “Kirkland Signature batteries” without naming sizes; Costco's Kirkland batteries in the US today are AA and AAA alkaline.
